meta.title: KUL Enterprises | Reliable Freight Transportation Built on Trust
meta.description: KUL Enterprises LLC is a licensed and insured freight carrier based in {location}. Power Only, Dry Van, Reefer, Dedicated, Regional, Expedited, and Over-the-Road service. Southeast based, nationwide. USDOT {usdot}, MC {mc}.

hero.lede: Freight services out of {location}, authorized in 48 states, dispatched around the clock.

statement.heading: Every shipment is a promise.
statement.body: A customer's business rides on every load we move. Communication stays honest, commitments are kept, and problems are solved on the road.

vision.heading: We grow the fleet before we sell the capacity.
vision.body: Written in the order it has to happen, with a date against nothing until it is booked.
